# SQLitePCLRaw redistribution records

The four resolved SQLitePCLRaw 2.1.13 package manifests each declare Apache-2.0.
These unmodified LICENSE.TXT and complete NOTICE.TXT records come from upstream
v2.1.12, commit ca835d21508bff43121c65081035840ac5006c4c:
https://github.com/ericsink/SQLitePCL.raw/tree/ca835d21508bff43121c65081035840ac5006c4c

Upstream exposes no v2.1.13 source tag at qualification time. The records preserve
SourceGear's Apache notice, SQLite's public-domain dedication, and upstream's
optional-configuration notices. Lightflow uses the standard e_sqlite3 bundle;
SQLCipher/cryptography components mentioned in the complete upstream NOTICE are
not introduced by this update. Both files are included unchanged in distributions.
